claims.claim: Atkinson published a paper showing that if accounting methods are kept constant over time, labor share has not fallen.
claims.context: Some might say labor share has been falling in the last 20 to 30 years. But there have been a lot of accounting changes in the last 30 to 40 years. For example, Atkinson has a paper showing that if you keep the accounting constant over the years, labor share hasn't even fallen ever.
